items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: The transcript only mentions 'His father' in the interviewer's question; the interviewee does not describe any personal relationship with Sidney Desvigne's father.

ctx.x: His father, did you ever hear any of the ragtime piano players there that go out to Turpin's, that jazz land, or the Booker T. Washington Theater? Did you ever get around St. Louis?
No, not much, no. Did you hear that?
